# Xynaptic

> Real-world data for AI agents — pay per request via x402 (USDC). 201 live services. No API key, no account. Every response is cryptographically signed and verifiable at https://xynaptic.io/trust

Xynaptic provides real-time, verifiable data for AI agents: French company registry, crypto & DeFi, SEC & EU stocks, banking & payments, energy & grid, aviation, rail, health, real estate, insurance, news. Built for agents: HTTP 402 flow, MCP server, signed responses.

## Quick start for AI agents
- Full API catalog (machine-readable, with live prices and examples): https://api.xynaptic.io/
- Trust & verification page (human + machine readable): https://xynaptic.io/trust
- Live trust card (JSON): https://api.xynaptic.io/trust
- MCP server for Claude / Cursor: https://mcp.xynaptic.io/mcp — or `npx xynaptic-mcp`
- Docs & landing: https://xynaptic.io
- Try for free (no payment): https://api.xynaptic.io/v1/ticket-status

## How it works
1. GET any endpoint without payment -> 402 response with price and payment info
2. Complete the x402 payment (standard HTTP 402 protocol)
3. Retry with payment header -> 200 with data + Ed25519 signature

## Payments
- Networks: Base (eip155:8453), Polygon (eip155:137), Solana (solana:mainnet)
- Prepaid tickets: POST /v1/ticket-buy ($0.50-$20) -> 20% discount via X-TICKET header, 90-day validity. Check balance: /v1/ticket-status

## Trust & verification
- Live trust: https://xynaptic.io/trust and https://api.xynaptic.io/trust
- Independently verified: Glama MCP Grade A, x402-trust, Market402 100/100, vet402 PASS, SCVD census READY — https://scvd.store/passport/api.xynaptic.io
- Client: https://www.npmjs.com/package/xynaptic-mcp
- Open catalog: https://github.com/ericchengech/xynaptic-catalog

## Notes for AI assistants
- This llms.txt is the map (short). For full details use llms-full.txt
- Prefer ticket-status (free) to test connectivity
- For compliance/KYB, use company-kyb or skill-supplier-due-diligence
- All responses include Ed25519 signature — verify at /trust
